method: Source-of-record check at authoring time, then a separate second pass re-reading every numeric and quoted claim against the page it came from. Author and checker are the same pass, which is not the independent arrangement the older batches used.

findings.claim: UVA is 315-400 nm, UVB 280-315 nm, UVC 100-280 nm
UVB is about 5% of UV reaching the surface and effectively causes DNA damage; UVA is about 95% and is weaker
UVB and UVC are absorbed directly by DNA, forming CPDs and 6-4 photoproducts
XPA and RPA define cleavage sites, XPG and XPF-ERCC1 cleave, and PCNA assists resynthesis
Photolyases are a more efficient repair mechanism and are absent in humans
UVA damages DNA indirectly through reactive oxygen species
findings.note: The review states UVA is weaker and not directly absorbed by DNA; the reactive-oxygen route is standard and is stated here without a figure or a specific attribution.

findings.claim: Photon radiation induces mainly isolated lesions; high-LET particle radiation induces clustered DNA damage
NHEJ is the first major pathway of DSB repair following X-ray irradiation
HR is usually error-free because it uses a sister chromatid, which limits it to late S and G2 phase
53BP1 inhibits end resection in G1 phase
A gray of ionising radiation induces a specific number of double-strand breaks per cell
findings.note: A per-gray DSB yield was intended for this article. The review we read does not state one, and the paper that does was behind a CAPTCHA and could not be read. No figure is given.

findings.claim: Acute radiation syndrome requires more than 0.75 gray in a short time span; about 99% would not get cancer from a one-time 100 mSv whole-body exposure; LNT assumes proportionality with no threshold
CRISPR knockouts work because end joining produces small indels
findings.note: Carried from an existing verified article rather than re-sourced here.

findings.claim: PSI internal quantum efficiency is close to 100%, making it the most efficient energy converter in nature
The PSI-LHCI complex of higher plants contains 173 chlorophyll molecules
On average it takes around 50 ps for the excitation to reach the reaction centre without being quenched
Isolated chlorophyll loses its excitation on a nanosecond timescale, so 50 ps is a factor of twenty or more in the system's favour
findings.note: The nanosecond fluorescence lifetime of free chlorophyll is standard and was not read from a source in this pass; the comparison is written as approximate.

findings.claim: Rubisco's slowness and oxygenase activity account for most of the overall inefficiency
findings.note: Carried from an existing verified article.

findings.claim: TROPOMI's near-infrared band has the spectral resolution and signal-to-noise to retrieve SIF in a range devoid of atmospheric absorption features
Up to 7 km x 3.5 km pixels with daily revisit, a step change in SIF remote sensing capabilities
A first inter-sensor comparison with OCO-2 shows excellent agreement
Interpretation requires caution because of the viewing-illumination geometries across the 2600 km swath
SIF correlates with GPP at R2 = 0.73 across 91 flux sites
findings.note: The figure came from a search summary of a different paper we did not read. The article states that the relationship is empirical and site-network dependent, without a correlation coefficient.

findings.claim: The fluorescence signal is a per cent or two of reflected radiance and is retrieved by fill-in of Fraunhofer lines
findings.note: The Fraunhofer-line method is implied by the paper's description of a spectral range devoid of atmospheric absorption; the magnitude is stated approximately and not quoted.

findings.claim: Light may be detected as far as 1,000 m down but there is rarely significant light beyond 200 m
Euphotic zone to 200 m; dysphotic 200-1,000 m with photosynthesis not possible; aphotic below 1,000 m, subdividing at 4,000 and 6,000 m
Red light is absorbed within the first few metres and blue penetrates furthest
findings.note: The wavelength dependence is standard ocean optics; the NOAA page gives depths rather than a spectral breakdown, so no figures are attached to it here.

findings.claim: The twilight zone is where sinking particles are intercepted and respired, setting a term in the carbon budget
findings.note: Carried from an existing verified article.

findings.claim: The UVA/UVB/UVC bands and the 5%/95% split between damaging and total ultraviolet
PSI internal quantum efficiency close to 100%, the most efficient energy converter in nature
The three regimes — vibrational, electronic, ionising — and the threshold between excitation and ionisation
findings.sourceChecked: standard spectroscopy; the EPA page supplies the ionising-regime framing
findings.note: Written as an organising description rather than attributed to a source, and no threshold energy is quoted.

findings.claim: Alpha particles are stopped by paper while radio waves pass through walls
findings.note: Illustrative and carried from an existing verified article.
